course_summary:
ISEN 667 | Engineering Economy | Spring 2026
Instructor: Hamid R. Parsaei | hamid.parsaei@tamu.edu
Meets: 9:35 -10:50 AM (CDT) | Room 2026, Emerging Technology Building (ETB)
Grading: Exam 1 [25%], Exam 2 [25%], Exam 3 [25%], Homework [12.5%], Quizzes [12.5%]
Topics: Nominal and Effective Interest Rates, Present Worth Values, Future Worth Values, Annual Worth Analysis, Rate of Return Analysis, Benefit/Cost Analysis, Public Sector Economics, Independent Projects with Budget Limitation, Breakeven Analysis, Payback Analysis, Depreciation Methods, Depletion Methods, Decision Making Under Risk, Foundations of Engineering Economy, Time and Interest Affect Money, Combining Factors, engineering economics principles, engineering decision problems, capital investment, engineering economic analysis techniques, alternative capital investments evaluation, income taxes, inflation, discounted cash flow analysis, competing projects, determination of rate of return on investment, risk and uncertainty in engineering analysis
Prerequisites: ISEN 303 or approval of instructor
